Xuwen lies south of the prefecture. The east, south, and west border the sea. To the west is the Haian Garrison Defense thousand-household post; to the east is the Jinnang Garrison Defense thousand-household post—both established in the tenth month of Hongwu 27. To the southwest is Dongchang; to the east is Ninghai—two patrol offices. Farther northwest was the Yuxian patrol office, later abolished.
144
廉州府元廉州路，屬海北海南道宣慰司。 洪武元年爲府。 七年十一月降爲州。 九年四月屬雷州府。 十四年五月復爲府。 領州一，縣二。 東距布政司千二百十里。
Lianzhou Prefecture was the Yuan Lianzhou Route under the Haibei-Hainan Circuit Pacification Commission. In Hongwu 1 it became a prefecture. In the eleventh month of Hongwu 7 it was reduced to a department. In the fourth month of Hongwu 9 it came under Leizhou Prefecture. In the fifth month of Hongwu 14 it was restored as a prefecture. It governed one department and two counties. It lay 1,210 li east of the Provincial Administration Commission.
145
合浦倚。 洪武七年十一月省，十四年五月復置。 東有大廉山，州以此名。 東南濱海，亦曰珠母海，以海中有珠池也。 又城北有廉江，亦曰合浦江，自廣西容縣流入，逕州，江口分爲五，西南注於海。 又北有石康縣，成化八年省。 東有永安守禦千戶所，洪武二十七年置。 東南有珠場、東北有永平二巡檢司。 又北有高仰巡檢司，治馬欄墟，後遷於縣西南。
Hepu (seat-attached county). It was abolished in the eleventh month of Hongwu 7 and re-established in the fifth month of Hongwu 14. To the east is Dalian Mountain, from which the department takes its name. The southeast borders the sea, also called the Pearl Mother Sea for the pearl beds offshore. North of the city wall is Lian River, also called the Hepu River, which enters from Rong County in Guangxi, passes through the department, splits into five channels at the mouth, and flows southwest into the sea. Farther north was Shikang County, abolished in Chenghua 8. To the east is the Yong'an Garrison Defense thousand-household post, established in Hongwu 27. To the southeast is Zhuchang; to the northeast is Yongping—two patrol offices. Farther north is the Gaoyang patrol office, originally at Malan Market, later moved southwest of the county.
146
欽州元欽州路，屬海北海南道。 洪武二年爲府。 七年十一月降爲州，以州治安遠縣省入。 九年四月降爲縣，來屬。 十四年五月復爲州。 西南濱海，中有烏雷山，入安南之要道也。 又有分茅嶺，亦與安南分界。 龍門江在城東，又東有欽江，俱入於海。 南有淞海、西南有長墩、西北有管界三巡檢司。 又西有如昔、又有佛淘二巡檢司，與交址接界，宣德二年入於安南，嘉靖二十一年復。 又西南有千金鎮。 東距府百四十里。 領縣一：
Qinzhou was the Yuan Qinzhou Route under the Haibei-Hainan Circuit. In Hongwu 2 it became a prefecture. In the eleventh month of Hongwu 7 it was reduced to a department, with seat-attached Anyuan County abolished and merged in. In the fourth month of Hongwu 9 it was reduced to a county and came under Lianzhou Prefecture. In the fifth month of Hongwu 14 it was restored as a department. The southwest borders the sea; offshore is Wulei Mountain, the vital route into Annam. There is also Fenmao Ridge, which marks the border with Annam. Longmen River lies east of the city; farther east the Qin River also flows into the sea. To the south is Songhai; to the southwest is Changdun; to the northwest is Guanjie—three patrol offices. Farther west are the Ruxi and Fotao patrol offices on the Jiaozhi border; in Xuande 2 they passed to Annam and were restored in Jiajing 21. Farther southwest is Qianjin Town. It lay 140 li east of the prefecture. It governed one county:
147
靈山州北。 元屬欽州。 洪武九年四月屬廉州。 十四年五月仍屬欽州。 北有洪崖山，洪崖江出焉，經縣東，與羅陽山水合，爲南岸江，南流爲欽江。 又南有林墟、西有西鄉二巡檢司。
Lingshan lies north of the department. Under the Yuan it belonged to Qinzhou. In the fourth month of Hongwu 9 it came under Lianzhou. In the fifth month of Hongwu 14 it again came under Qin Prefecture. To the north is Hongya Mountain, where the Hongya River rises; it passes east of the county, joins the waters of Luoyang Mountain to form the South Bank River, and flows south as the Qin River. Farther south is Linxu; to the west is Xixiang—two patrol offices.
148
瓊州府元乾寧軍民安撫司。 元統二年十月改爲乾寧安撫司，屬海北海南道宣慰司。 洪武元年十月改爲瓊州府。 二年降爲州。 三年仍升爲府。 領州三，縣十。 東北距布政司千七百五十里。
Qiongzhou Prefecture was the Yuan Qianning Military-Civilian Pacification Commission. In the tenth month of Zhishun 2 it was renamed the Qianning Pacification Commission under the Haibei-Hainan Circuit Pacification Commission. In the tenth month of Hongwu 1 it became Qiongzhou Prefecture. In Hongwu 2 it was reduced from a prefecture to a zhou. In Hongwu 3 it was again raised to prefecture status. It governed three prefectures and ten counties. It lay 1,750 li northeast of the Provincial Administration Commission.
149
瓊山倚。 南有瓊山。 北濱海，有神應港，亦曰海口渡，有海口守禦千戶所，洪武二十年十月置。 又西南有水蕉村，萬曆二十八年置水會守禦千戶所於此。 南有石山。 又有清瀾巡檢司，廢。
Qiongshan (seat-attached county). To the south is Qiong Mountain. The north borders the sea; there is Shenying Port, also called Haikou Crossing, where the Haikou Garrison Defense thousand-household post was established in the tenth month of Hongwu 20. Farther southwest is Shuijiao Village, where the Shuihui Garrison Defense thousand-household post was established in Wanli 28. To the south is Stone Mountain. There was also the Qinglan patrol office, now abolished.
150
澄邁府西。 北濱海。 南有黎母江。 東有澄江。 西北有澄邁巡檢司，治石矍都。 南有兔穎巡檢司，治曾家東都，後遷南黎都，廢。 西南有銅鼓巡檢司，治新安都，後遷西黎都，廢。 又有那拖巡檢司，治那拖市，後遷縣西森山市，廢。
Chengmai lies west of the prefecture. The north borders the sea. To the south is the Limu River. To the east is the Cheng River. To the northwest is the Chengmai patrol office, stationed at Shijue District. To the south was the Tuying patrol office, stationed at Zengjia East District, later moved to Nanli District and abolished. To the southwest was the Tonggu patrol office, stationed at Xin'an District, later moved to Xili District and abolished. There was also the Natuo patrol office, stationed at Natuo Market, later moved to Sen Mountain City west of the county and abolished.
151
臨高府西。 北濱海。 南有黎母江。 南有田牌巡檢司，後遷墳橫岡。 又東有定南、北有博鋪二巡檢司，廢。
Lingao lies west of the prefecture. The north borders the sea. To the south is the Limu River. To the south is the Tianpai patrol office, later moved to Fenhenggang. Farther east was Dingnan; to the north was Bopu—two patrol offices, now abolished.
152
安定府南。 元至元二十九年六月置。 天曆二年十月升爲南建州。 洪武元年十月復爲縣。 南有五指山，亦曰黎母山，黎人環居山下，外爲熟黎，內爲生黎。 北有建江，繞郡境西北流，入南渡江。 東有潭覽屯田千戶所，元置，洪武中因之，永樂四年廢。 西有青寧巡檢司。 又東有寧村巡檢司，治潭覽村，後遷縣東南南資都，仍故名。
Anding lies south of the prefecture. Under the Yuan it was established in the sixth month of Zhiyuan 29. In the tenth month of Tianshi 2 it was raised to Nanjian Prefecture. In the tenth month of Hongwu 1 it was restored to county status. To the south is Wuzhi Mountain, also known as Limu Mountain, around whose foot the Li people dwell in a ring—the acculturated Li outside, the unacculturated Li within. To the north is the Jian River, which flows northwest along the border and enters the Nandu River. To the east is the Tanlan garrison-farm thousand-household post, established under the Yuan and retained in the Hongwu reign until abolished in Yongle 4. To the west is the Qingning patrol office. Farther east is the Ningcun patrol office, stationed at Tanlan Village, later moved to Nanzhi District southeast of the county while keeping its former name.
153
文昌府東。 西北有七星山。 南有紫貝山。 東北濱海。 東南有文昌江，入於海。 又東北有清瀾守禦千戶所，洪武二十七年八月置，萬曆九年遷縣東南南毛都陳家村。 西北有鋪前巡檢司。 東北有青藍頭巡檢司，後遷縣東抱凌港。
Wenchang lies east of the prefecture. To the northwest is Seven Stars Mountain. To the south is Zibei Mountain. The northeast borders the sea. To the southeast is the Wenchang River, which flows into the sea. Farther northeast is the Qinglan Garrison Defense thousand-household post, established in the eighth month of Hongwu 27 and moved in Wanli 9 to Chen Family Village in Nanmao District southeast of the county. To the northwest is the Puqian patrol office. To the northeast is the Qinglantou patrol office, later moved to Baoling Harbor east of the county.
154
會同府東南。 元至元二十九年六月置。 東濱海。 西有黎盆溪，東有調囂巡檢司，治端趙都，尋遷縣東南南滄村。
Huitong lies southeast of the prefecture. Under the Yuan it was established in the sixth month of Zhiyuan 29. The east borders the sea. To the west is Lipen Stream; to the east is the Diaoxiao patrol office, originally at Duanzhao District, soon moved to Nancun Village southeast of the county.
155
樂會府東南。 西有白石山。 東濱海。 西北有萬泉河，有黎盆水流入焉。
Lehui lies southeast of the prefecture. To the west is White Stone Mountain. The east borders the sea. To the northwest is the Wanquan River, into which the Lipen Water flows.
156
儋州元南寧軍，屬海北海南道宣慰司。 洪武元年十月改爲儋州，屬府。 正統四年六月以州治宜倫縣省入。 西北有龍門嶺。 西濱海。 北有倫江。 西南有鎮南、又有安海二巡檢司。 又東有歸姜巡檢司，廢。 東北距府三百七十里。 領縣一：
Dan Prefecture was the Yuan Nanning Military Commission under the Haibei-Hainan Circuit Pacification Commission. In the tenth month of Hongwu 1 it became Dan Prefecture under Qiongzhou. In the sixth month of Zhengtong 4, seat-attached Yilun County was abolished and merged into the prefecture. To the northwest is Longmen Ridge. The west borders the sea. To the north is the Lun River. To the southwest is Zhennan; there is also Anhai—two patrol offices. Farther east was the Guijiang patrol office, now abolished. It lay 370 li northeast of the prefecture. It governed one county:
157
昌化州南。 舊城在東南，今城本昌化守禦千戶所，洪武二十五年置。 正統六年五月徙縣治焉。 西濱海。 南有昌江。
Changhua lies south of the prefecture. The old city was in the southeast; the present seat was originally the Changhua Garrison Defense thousand-household post, established in Hongwu 25. In the fifth month of Zhengtong 6 the county seat was moved here. The west borders the sea. To the south is the Chang River.
158
萬州元萬安軍，屬海北海南道。 洪武元年十月改爲萬州，屬府。 正統四年六月以州治萬安縣省入。 北有六連山，龍滾河出焉。 東南海中有獨洲山。 東有蓮塘巡檢司，後廢。 西北距府四百七十里。 領縣一：
Wan Prefecture was the Yuan Wan'an Military Commission under the Haibei-Hainan Circuit. In the tenth month of Hongwu 1 it became Wan Prefecture under Qiongzhou. In the sixth month of Zhengtong 4, seat-attached Wan'an County was abolished and merged into the prefecture. To the north is Liulian Mountain, where the Longgun River rises. In the sea to the southeast is Duzhou Island. To the east was the Liantang patrol office, later abolished. It lay 470 li northwest of the prefecture. It governed one county:
159
陵水州南。 東北有舊縣城，今治本南山守禦千戶所，洪武二十七年置。 正統間，遷縣於此。 西有小五指山。 東濱海，海中有雙女嶼。 東北有牛嶺巡檢司。
Lingshui lies south of the prefecture. The old county seat was in the northeast; the present seat is the Nanshan Garrison Defense thousand-household post, established in Hongwu 27. During the Zhengtong reign the county seat was moved here. To the west is Little Wuzhi Mountain. The east borders the sea; offshore are the Twin Maidens Islets. To the northeast is the Niuling patrol office.
160
崖州元吉陽軍，屬海北海南道宣慰司。 洪武元年十月改爲崖州，屬府。 正統四年六月以州治寧遠縣省入。 南有南山。 北有大河，自五指山分流，南入海。 東有滕橋、西有抱歲、又西北有通遠三巡檢司。 北距府千四百一十里。 領縣一：
Ya Prefecture was the Yuan Jiyang Military Commission under the Haibei-Hainan Circuit Pacification Commission. In the tenth month of Hongwu 1 it became Ya Prefecture under Qiongzhou. In the sixth month of Zhengtong 4, seat-attached Ningyuan County was abolished and merged into the prefecture. To the south is South Mountain. To the north is the Great River, branching from Wuzhi Mountain and flowing south into the sea. To the east is Tengqiao; to the west is Baosui; farther northwest is Tongyuan—three patrol offices. It lay 1,410 li north of the prefecture. It governed one county:
161
感恩州西北。 舊屬儋州。 正統五年來屬。 西濱海。 南有南湘江，源自黎母山，西南入於海。 東南有延德巡檢司。
Gan'en lies northwest of the prefecture. Formerly it belonged to Dan Prefecture. In Zhengtong 5 it came under Qiongzhou Prefecture. The west borders the sea. To the south is the Nanxiang River, rising on Limu Mountain and flowing southwest into the sea. To the southeast is the Yande patrol office.
162
東安州東。 萬曆五年十一月以瀧水縣東山黃姜峒置，析德慶州及高要、新興二縣地益之。 北有西江，西有瀧水流入焉。 東北有南鄉守禦千戶所，西南有富霖守禦千戶所，俱萬曆五年五月置。 東南有羅苛巡檢司。
Dong'an lies east of the prefecture. In the eleventh month of Wanli 5 it was established from Huangjiang Cave in the eastern hills of Longshui County, with territory taken from Deqing Prefecture and from Gaoyao and Xinxing counties. To the north is the Xi River, into which the Longshui flows from the west. To the northeast is the Nanxiang Garrison Defense thousand-household post; to the southwest is the Fulin Garrison Defense thousand-household post—both established in the fifth month of Wanli 5. To the southeast is the Luoke patrol office.
163
西寧州西。 萬曆五年十一月以瀧水縣西山大峒置，析德慶州及封川縣地益之。 東北有西江，與德慶州分界。 東南有瀧水。 西南有封門守禦千戶所，萬曆五年五月置。 北有都城鄉巡檢司。 又西南有懷鄉巡檢司，後廢。
Xining lies west of the prefecture. In the eleventh month of Wanli 5 it was established from Xishan Dacave in Luoshui County, with territory taken from Deqing Prefecture and Fengchuan County. To the northeast is the Xi River, which forms the boundary with Deqing Prefecture. To the southeast is Luoshui. To the southwest is the Fengmen Garrison Defense thousand-household post, established in the fifth month of Wanli 5. To the north is the Ducheng Township patrol office. Farther southwest was the Huaixiang patrol office, later abolished.
164
廣西《禹貢》荊州之域及荊、揚二州之徼外。 元置廣西兩江道宣慰使司，治靜江路。 屬湖廣行中書省。 至正末，改宣慰使司爲廣西等處行中書省。 洪武二年三月因之。 六年四月置廣西都衛。 與行中書省同治。 八年十月改都衛爲都指揮使司。 九年六月改行中書省爲承宣布政使司。 領府十一，州四十有八，縣五十，長官司四。 爲裏一千一百八十三。 北至懷遠，與湖廣、貴州界。 東至梧州，與廣東界。 西至太平，與貴州、雲南界。 南至博白，與廣東界。 距南京四千二百九十五里，京師七千四百六十二里。 洪武二十六年編戶二十一萬一千二百六十三，口一百四十八萬二千六百七十一。 弘治四年，戶四十五萬九千六百四十，口一百六十七萬六千二百七十四。 萬曆六年，戶二十一萬八千七百一十二，口一百一十八萬六千一百七十九。
Guangxi fell within Jing Province in the Tribute of Yu and lay beyond the outer marches of Jing and Yang provinces. The Yuan established the Guangxi Liangjiang Circuit Pacification Commission with its seat at Jingjiang Route. It was subordinate to the Huguang Branch Secretariat. At the end of the Zhizheng era the Pacification Commission was converted into the Guangxi Branch Secretariat. In the third month of Hongwu 2 the arrangement was retained. In the fourth month of Hongwu 6 the Guangxi Regional Guard was established. It was co-administered with the Branch Secretariat. In the tenth month of Hongwu 8 the Regional Guard became the Guangxi Regional Military Commission. In the sixth month of Hongwu 9 the Branch Secretariat became the Provincial Administration Commission. It governed eleven prefectures, forty-eight subprefectures, fifty counties, and four native chieftaincies. Its registered area was 1,183 li. To the north it reached Huaiyuan and bordered Huguang and Guizhou. To the east it reached Wuzhou and bordered Guangdong. To the west it reached Taiping and bordered Guizhou and Yunnan. To the south it reached Bobai and bordered Guangdong. It lay 4,295 li from Nanjing and 7,762 li from the capital. In the Hongwu 26 registration there were 211,263 households and 1,482,671 persons. In Hongzhi 4 there were 459,640 households and 1,676,274 persons. In Wanli 6 there were 218,712 households and 1,186,179 persons.
165
桂林府元靜江路。 洪武元年爲府。 五年六月改爲桂林府。 領州二，縣七：
Guilin Prefecture was the Yuan Jingjiang Route. In Hongwu 1 it became a prefecture. In the sixth month of Hongwu 5 it was renamed Guilin Prefecture. It governed two subprefectures and seven counties:
166
臨桂倚。 洪武三年七月建靖江王府於獨秀峯前。 東有桂山。 東北有堯山。 又有桂江，亦曰灕江，南有陽江來合焉，至蒼梧縣合於左、右江。 東有蘆田市、西有兩江口二巡檢司。 南有湘山渡巡檢司，後廢。
Lingui (seat-attached county). In the seventh month of Hongwu 3 the Jingjiang princely residence was built before Solitary Beauty Peak. To the east is Gui Mountain. To the northeast is Yao Mountain. There is also the Gui River, also called the Li River; from the south the Yang River flows into it, and at Cangwu County it joins the Left and Right rivers. To the east is the Lutian Market patrol office; to the west is the Liangjiangkou patrol office. To the south was the Xiangshandu patrol office, later abolished.
167
興安府北。 南有海陽山，湘水出其北，流入湖廣永州府界，灕水出其南，南入梧州府界。 北有越城嶺，亦曰始安嶠，五嶺之最西嶺，下有始安水流入灕水。 西南有融江六峒、西有鹽砂寨、北有唐家鋪三巡檢司。 又西南有巖關。
Xing'an lies north of the prefecture. To the south is Haiyang Mountain; the Xiang River rises to its north and flows into Yong Prefecture in Huguang, while the Li River rises to its south and flows south into Wuzhou Prefecture. To the north is Yuecheng Ridge, also called Shi'an Pass—the westernmost of the Five Ridges—below which Shi'an Water flows into the Li River. To the southwest is the Rongjiang Liudong patrol office; to the west is the Yansha Stockade patrol office; to the north is the Tangjiapu patrol office. Farther southwest is Yan Pass.
168
靈川府北。 北有百丈山。 東北有融江，源出融山二洞中，一名銀江，流經縣境，又南入靈川縣界，合於灕江。 南有白石潭、東北有千秋峽二巡檢司。
Lingchuan lies north of the prefecture. To the north is Baizhang Mountain. To the northeast is the Rong River, rising from twin caves in Rong Mountain—also called the Yin River—which runs through the county and farther south joins the Li River. To the south is the Baishitan patrol office; to the northeast is the Qianqiuxia patrol office.
169
陽朔府南。 北有陽朔山。 東有灕江。 東南有伏荔市、南有都樂墟二巡檢司。 西有白竹寨巡檢司，廢。
Yangshuo lies south of the prefecture. To the north is Yangshuo Mountain. To the east is the Li River. To the southeast is the Fulishi Market patrol office; to the south is the Dulexu patrol office. To the west was the Baizhu Stockade patrol office, now abolished.
170
全州元全州路，屬湖廣道。 洪武元年爲府。 九年四月降爲州，省州治清湘縣入焉，屬湖廣永州府。 二十七年八月來屬。 西有湘山。 南有湘水，又北有洮水流合焉。 又西有西延、西南有建安、東北有柳浦三巡檢司。 又東北有平塘巡檢司，廢。 南距府二百五十里。 領縣一：
Quan Prefecture was the Yuan Quanzhou Route under Huguang Circuit. In Hongwu 1 it became a prefecture. In the fourth month of Hongwu 9 it was reduced to a subprefecture, with seat-attached Qingxiang County abolished and merged in, and placed under Yong Prefecture in Huguang. In the eighth month of Hongwu 27 it came under [Guilin Prefecture's] jurisdiction. To the west is Xiang Mountain. To the south is the Xiang River, and from the north the Tao River flows into it. Farther west is the Xiyan patrol office; to the southwest is the Jian'an patrol office; to the northeast is the Liupu patrol office. Farther northeast was the Pingtang patrol office, now abolished. It lay 250 li south of the prefecture. It governed one county:
171
灌陽州南少東。 南有灌水，經州界，合於湘水。 西南有吉寧鄉崇順裏巡檢司。
Guanyang lies south-southeast of the subprefecture. To the south is the Guan River, which passes through the subprefecture and joins the Xiang River. To the southwest is the Jining Township Chongshunli patrol office.
172
永寧州元古縣。 洪武十四年改爲古田縣。 隆慶五年三月升爲永寧州。 縣舊治在今州南三十里。 洪武初，移於今州南八里。 成化十八年又移今治。 又有黃源水，下流入灕江。 南有桐木鎮、又有常安鎮、西南有富椽鎮三土巡檢司。 東距府百五十里。 領縣二：
Yongning Subprefecture was originally Gu County under the Yuan. In Hongwu 14 it was renamed Gutian County. In the third month of Longqing 5 it was elevated to Yongning Subprefecture. The old county seat lay 30 li south of the present subprefecture. At the beginning of the Hongwu reign it was moved to 8 li south of the present subprefecture. In Chenghua 18 it was moved again to the present seat. There is also Huangyuan Water, which flows down into the Li River. To the south is the Tongmu Town native patrol office; there is also the Chang'an Town native patrol office; to the southwest is the Fuchuan Town native patrol office. It lay 150 li east of the prefecture. It governed two counties:
173
永福州東南。 舊屬府，隆慶五年三月改屬州。 西南有太和山，太和江環其下，東入柳州府，爲雒清江。 又西南有理定縣，元屬靜江舊路，正統五年九月省。 又有蘭麻鎮、東北有銅鼓市二巡檢司，廢。
Yongfu lies southeast of the subprefecture. Formerly under Guilin Prefecture; in the third month of Longqing 5 it was transferred to the subprefecture. To the southwest is Taihe Mountain; the Taihe River circles its base, flows east into Liuzhou Prefecture, and becomes the Luoqing River. Farther southwest was Liding County, under the Yuan Jingjiang Old Route; it was abolished in the ninth month of Zhengtong 5. There were also the Lanma Town and Tonggu Market patrol offices to the northeast—both abolished.
174
義寧州東北，舊屬府，隆慶五年三月改屬州。 北有丁嶺，義江出焉，下流分爲二，東流者爲臨桂縣之相思水，入於灕江，南流者爲永福縣之白石水，即太和江也。 西北有桑江口巡檢司。
Yining lies northeast of the subprefecture; formerly under Guilin Prefecture, in the third month of Longqing 5 it was transferred to the subprefecture. To the north is Ding Ridge, where the Yi River rises; below it divides into two branches—the eastern branch becomes Xiangsi Water in Lingui County and enters the Li River, while the southern branch becomes Baishi Water in Yongfu County, which is the Taihe River. To the northwest is the Sangjiangkou patrol office.
175
平樂府元大德五年十一月置。 洪武元年因之。 領州一，縣七。 北距布政司百九十里。
Pingle Prefecture was established in the eleventh month of the Yuan Dade 5. In Hongwu 1 the arrangement was retained. It governed one subprefecture and seven counties. It lay 190 li north of the Provincial Administration Commission.
176
平樂倚。 東南有魯溪山。 西北有灕江，又北有樂川水，東經昭潭流合焉。 又東有榕津寨巡檢司，又有水滻營土巡檢司。 又東有龍平寨巡檢司、昭平堡土巡檢司，廢。 又東有團山堡，東南有廣運堡、足灘堡，又南有甑灘堡，俱弘治後置。
Pingle (seat-attached county). To the southeast is Luxi Mountain. To the northwest is the Li River; from the north the Lechuan River flows east through Zhaotan and joins it. Farther east is the Rongjin Stockade patrol office; there is also the Shuichanying native patrol office. Farther east were the Longping Stockade and Zhaoping Fort native patrol offices—both abolished. Farther east is Tuanshan Fort; to the southeast are Guangyun and Zutan forts; farther south is Zengtan Fort—all established after the Hongzhi reign.
177
恭城府東北。 南有樂川水，又東有勢江，南有南平江，北有平川江，西南有西水江，俱流合焉。 東北有鎮峽寨、東有勢江源二巡檢司。 又有白麪寨、西嶺寨二土巡檢司。
Gongcheng lies northeast of the prefecture. To the south is the Lechuan River; from the east comes the Shi River; from the south the Nanping River; from the north the Pingchuan River; from the southwest the Xishui River—all unite here. To the northeast is the Zhenxia Stockade patrol office; to the east is the Shijiangyuan patrol office. There are also the Baimian and Xiling stockade native patrol offices.
178
富川府東少北。 元屬賀州。 洪武十年五月改屬潯州府，後來屬。 西南有鐘山縣，舊治於此，洪武二十九年十一月移治靄石山下，而置邊蓬寨巡檢司於舊治。 北有秦山，接湖廣道州界。 東北有氓渚嶺，即臨賀嶺，與湖廣江華縣分界。 又東有富江，南合賀水。 西南有白霞寨、西北有寨下市二巡檢司。
Fuchuan lies east-northeast of the prefecture. Under the Yuan it belonged to He Prefecture. In the fifth month of Hongwu 10 it was transferred to Xun Prefecture, later coming under Ping Prefecture. To the southwest is the old seat of Zhongshan County. In the eleventh month of Hongwu 29 the seat was moved to the foot of Aishi Mountain, and the Bianpeng Stockade patrol office was placed at the former site. To the north is Qin Mountain, on the border with Daozhou in Huguang. To the northeast is Mangzhu Ridge, also called Linhe Ridge, which marks the boundary with Jianghua County in Huguang. Farther east is the Fu River, which is joined from the south by He Water. To the southwest is the Baixia Stockade patrol office; to the northwest is the Zhaixia Market patrol office.
179
賀府東南。 元賀州，直隸廣西兩江道。 洪武初，以州治臨賀縣省入，屬潯州府。 十年五月降爲縣，後來屬。 東北有臨賀嶺，亦曰桂嶺，下有桂嶺縣，元末廢。 東有賀江，至廣東封川縣合於西江。 南有信都鄉巡檢司。 北有沙田寨巡檢司，後遷縣西點燈寨，尋廢。 又東北有大寧寨、樊字寨、白花洞三土巡檢司，後廢。
He County lies southeast of the prefecture. Under the Yuan it was He Prefecture, directly subordinate to Guangxi's Liangjiang Circuit. At the beginning of the Hongwu reign the seat-attached Linhe County was abolished and merged in, and the prefecture came under Xun Prefecture. In the fifth month of Hongwu 10 it was reduced to a county, later coming under Ping Prefecture. To the northeast is Linhe Ridge, also known as Guiling Ridge; below it once stood Guiling County, abolished at the end of the Yuan. To the east is the He River, which at Fengchuan County in Guangdong joins the Xi River. To the south is the Xindu Township patrol office. To the north is the Shatian Stockade patrol office, later moved to Diandeng Stockade west of the county and soon abolished. Farther northeast were the Daning Stockade, Fanzi Stockade, and Baihuadong indigenous patrol offices, all later abolished.
180
荔浦府西少南。 舊屬桂林府，弘治四年來屬。 舊治在今縣西。 景泰七年移於後山，即今治。 東有銅鼓嶺，一名火焰山。 又荔江在南，下流入灕江。 東南有峯門寨巡檢司，後遷中峒。 西北有南原寨巡檢司，後遷縣東南下峒，又遷縣東延濱江。 又西南有華蓋城，萬曆中築。
Lipu lies west and slightly south of the prefecture. Formerly under Guilin Prefecture; in Hongzhi 4 it came under Ping Prefecture. The old seat lay west of the present county. In Jingtai 7 it was moved to Rear Mountain—the present seat. To the east is Tonggu Ridge, also called Flame Mountain. Farther south is the Lijiang, whose lower course flows into the Li River. To the southeast is the Fengmen Stockade patrol office, later moved to Zhongdong. To the northwest is the Nanyuan Stockade patrol office, later moved to Xiadong southeast of the county, then to Yanbinjiang east of the county. Farther southwest is Huagai Fortress, built during the Wanli reign.
181
修仁府西少南。 舊屬桂林府，弘治四年來屬。 舊治在今縣西馬浪坪。 景泰初，遷今縣南霸寨村。 成化十五年遷於五福嶺，即今治。 東北有荔江，有麗壁市土巡檢司。 西南有石牆堡，萬曆間築。
Xiuren lies west and slightly south of the prefecture. Formerly under Guilin Prefecture; in Hongzhi 4 it came under Ping Prefecture. The old seat was at Malangping, west of the present county. At the beginning of the Jingtai reign it was moved to Bazhai Village south of the present county. In Chenghua 15 it was moved to Wufu Ridge—the present seat. To the northeast is the Lijiang; there is the Libi Market indigenous patrol office. To the southwest is Shiqiang Fortress, built during the Wanli reign.
182
昭平府南少東。 萬曆四年四月析平樂、富川二縣地置。 五年又析賀縣地益之。 東有五指山。 又有灕江。 又有思勤江，下流入於灕江。 東南有龍平縣，元屬府，洪武十八年廢。
Zhaoping lies south and slightly east of the prefecture. In the fourth month of Wanli 4 it was established from territory carved out of Pingl and Fuchuan counties. In Wanli 5 territory from He County was added to it. To the east is Wuzhi Mountain. There is also the Li River. There is also the Siqin River, whose lower course flows into the Li River. To the southeast is the former site of Longping County, which under the Yuan belonged to the prefecture and was abolished in Hongwu 18.
183
永安州元立山縣，屬府。 洪武十八年廢爲立山鄉，屬荔浦縣。 成化十三年二月置州，曰永安，屬桂林府。 弘治三年九月改爲長官司。 五年復爲州，來屬。 東有蒙山，下有蒙水。 南有古眉寨土巡檢司。 北有羣峯寨土巡檢司，後遷州西北杜莫寨，又遷州北貓兒堡。 東南有仙回營，萬曆中置。 東北距府百二十里。
Yong'an Subprefecture was Lishan County under the Yuan, belonging to the prefecture. In Hongwu 18 it was abolished and made Lishan Township, subordinate to Lipu County. In the second month of Chenghua 13 a subprefecture called Yong'an was established, under Guilin Prefecture. In the ninth month of Hongzhi 3 it was converted to a native official office. In Hongzhi 5 it was restored as a subprefecture and came under Ping Prefecture. To the east is Meng Mountain, at whose foot flows Meng Water. To the south is the Gumei Stockade indigenous patrol office. To the north is the Qunfeng Stockade indigenous patrol office, later moved to Dumo Stockade northwest of the subprefecture, then to Mao'er Fort north of the subprefecture. To the southeast is Xianhui Camp, established during the Wanli reign. It lay 120 li northeast of the prefecture.
184
梧州府元梧州路。 洪武元年爲府。 領州一，縣九。 北距布政司五百八十里。
Wuzhou Prefecture was the Yuan Wuzhou Route. In Hongwu 1 it became a prefecture. It governed one subprefecture and nine counties. It lay 580 li north of the Provincial Administration Commission.
185
蒼梧倚。 城西南有大江，江即黔、鬱二水，合流於潯州府城東，爲潯江； 入府界，東經立山下，又東經此，與桂江合，謂之三江口，下流爲廣東之西江。 東有長行、西有安平、北有東安、西南有羅粒四巡檢司。
Cangwu (seat-attached county). Southwest of the city is the Great River—the Qian and Yu waters, which join east of Xun Prefecture to form the Xun River; entering the prefectural boundary it runs east past Lishan, then east past here to join the Gui River at Three Rivers Mouth; downstream it becomes the Xi River of Guangdong. To the east is Changxing; to the west is Anping; to the north is Dong'an; to the southwest is Luoli—four patrol offices.
186
藤府西。 元藤州。 直隸廣西兩江道。 洪武二年九月省州治鐔津縣入焉。 十月來屬。 十年五月降爲縣。 北有藤江，亦曰鐔江，即潯江也。 東南有繡江，西有幕僚江，俱流入焉。 又西北有五屯守禦千戶所，嘉靖初置。 西有白石寨、南有竇家寨、東北有赤水鎮三巡檢司。 又東有溻洲、南有周村、西南有驛面、又南有思羅四巡檢司，廢。
Teng County lies west of the prefecture. Under the Yuan it was Teng Prefecture. It was directly subordinate to Guangxi's Liangjiang Circuit. In the ninth month of Hongwu 2 the seat-attached Tanjin County was abolished and merged in. In the tenth month it came under Wuzhou Prefecture. In the fifth month of Hongwu 10 it was reduced to a county. To the north is the Teng River, also called the Tan River—it is the Xun River. From the southeast the Xiujiang flows in; from the west the Muliao River flows in. Farther northwest is the Wutun Garrison Defense thousand-household post, established at the beginning of the Jiajing reign. To the west is the Baishi Stockade patrol office; to the south is the Doujia Stockade patrol office; to the northeast is the Chishui Town patrol office. Farther east was Tayu; to the south was Zhou Village; to the southwest was Yimian; farther south was Siluo—four patrol offices, all abolished.
187
容府西南。 元容州，直隸廣西兩江道。 洪武二年十月來屬。 十年五月降爲縣，省州治普寧縣入焉。 西北有容山。 南有容江，亦名繡江。 又東有波羅裏大洞、西南有粉壁寨二巡檢司。
Rong County lies southwest of the prefecture. Under the Yuan it was Rong Prefecture, directly subordinate to Guangxi's Liangjiang Circuit. In the tenth month of Hongwu 2 it came under Wuzhou Prefecture. In the fifth month of Hongwu 10 it was reduced to a county, with seat-attached Puning County abolished and merged in. To the northwest is Rong Mountain. To the south is the Rong River, also known as the Xiujiang. Farther east is the Boluoli Great Cave patrol office; to the southwest is the Fenbi Stockade patrol office.
188
岑溪府南少西。 元屬藤州。 洪武十年五月改屬府。 東北有烏峽山。 西有繡江。 東南有上裏平河村、西南有南渡二巡檢司。 又東南有連城鄉義平巡檢司，廢。
Cenxi lies south and slightly west of the prefecture. Under the Yuan it belonged to Teng Prefecture. In the fifth month of Hongwu 10 it was transferred to Wuzhou Prefecture. To the northeast is Wuxia Mountain. To the west is the Xiujiang. To the southeast is the Shangli Pinghe Village patrol office; to the southwest is the Nandu patrol office. Farther southeast was the Liancheng Township Yiping patrol office, now abolished.
189
懷集府東北。 元屬賀州。 洪武初，屬平樂府。 十年五月來屬。 西南有懷溪水。 東有武城鄉、西有慈樂寨、西北有蘭峒寨三巡檢司。
Huaiji lies northeast of the prefecture. Under the Yuan it belonged to He Prefecture. At the beginning of the Hongwu reign it belonged to Ping Prefecture. In the fifth month of Hongwu 10 it came under Wuzhou Prefecture. To the southwest is Huaiji Stream. To the east is the Wucheng Township patrol office; to the west is the Cile Stockade patrol office; to the northwest is the Landong Stockade patrol office.
190
鬱林州元直隸廣西兩江道。 洪武二年九月以州治南流縣省入。 十月來屬。 南有南流江，至廣東合浦縣入海。 有橫嶺、文俊二巡檢司，廢。 東北距府三百三十里。 領縣四：
Yulin Subprefecture was directly subordinate to Guangxi's Liangjiang Circuit under the Yuan. In the ninth month of Hongwu 2 the seat-attached Nanliu County was abolished and merged in. In the tenth month it came under Wuzhou Prefecture. To the south is the Nanliu River, which at Hepu County in Guangdong enters the sea. There were the Hengling and Wenjun patrol offices, both abolished. It lay 330 li northeast of the prefecture. It governed four counties:
191
博白州西南。 西有雙角山，綠珠江出其下，流合縣南飲馬水，下流入南流江。 南有周羅、西南有沙河二巡檢司。 又有安定、春臺、平山、兆常四土巡檢司，尋廢。 又東南有海門鎮，舊爲入安南之道。
Bobai lies southwest of the subprefecture. To the west is Shuangjiao Mountain; the Lüzhu River rises at its foot, joins Yinma Water south of the county, and flows down into the Nanliu River. To the south is the Zhouluo patrol office; to the southwest is the Shahe patrol office. There were also the Anding, Chuntai, Pingshan, and Zhaochang indigenous patrol offices, soon abolished. Farther southeast is Haimen Town, once the route into Annam.
192
北流州北。 元屬容州。 洪武十年五月來屬。 東北有勾漏山。 東有銅石山，產水銀、硃砂。 又南有扶來山，陵水出焉，西南有峨石山，羅水出焉，俱流入廣東化州界。 又北有綠藍山，綠藍水出焉，分爲二。 東流者經城東登龍橋，與廣東高州府流入之繡江合，又東經容縣，爲容江。 西流者入鬱林州，爲南流江。 南有雙威寨巡檢司。 西有都隴、又有中山、又有清灣三巡檢司，廢。 又西有天門關，本名鬼門關，洪武初，改爲桂門關； 宣德中，更今名。
Beiliu lies north of the subprefecture. Under the Yuan it belonged to Rong Prefecture. In the fifth month of Hongwu 10 it came under Wuzhou Prefecture. To the northeast is Gouluo Mountain. To the east is Tongshi Mountain, which yields mercury and cinnabar. Farther south is Fulai Mountain, source of the Ling River; to the southwest is Eshi Mountain, where the Luo River begins. Both streams flow into the territory of Huazhou in Guangdong. Farther north is Lülan Mountain; the Lülan River rises there and splits in two. The eastern branch passes Denglong Bridge east of the city, joins the Xiujiang flowing in from Gaozhou Prefecture in Guangdong, then runs east through Rong County as the Rong River. The western branch enters Yulin Prefecture and becomes the Nanliu River. To the south is the Shuangwei Stockade patrol office. To the west were the Dulong, Zhongshan, and Qingwan patrol offices, all abolished. Farther west is Tianmen Pass, originally called Guimen Pass; at the beginning of the Hongwu reign it was renamed Gui Gate Pass; during the Xuande reign it received its present name.
193
陸川州南少東。 元屬容州。 洪武十年五月來屬。 舊爲入安南之道。 東有龍化江，下流合容江。 南有溫水寨巡檢司。
Luchuan lies south and slightly east of the prefecture. Under the Yuan it belonged to Rong Prefecture. In the fifth month of Hongwu 10 it came under Wuzhou Prefecture. It was formerly the route into Annam. To the east is the Longhua River, whose lower course joins the Rong River. To the south is the Wenshui Stockade patrol office.
194
興業州西少北。 南有鐵城山。 北有翻車嶺，龍母江出焉，下流入南流江。 南有趙家寨、西有長寧寨、北有平安寨、又有棠木寨四巡檢司，後俱廢。
Xingye lies west and slightly north of the prefecture. To the south is Tiecheng Mountain. To the north is Fanche Ridge; the Longmu River rises there and flows down into the Nanliu River. To the south was the Zhaojia Stockade patrol office; to the west was the Changning Stockade patrol office; to the north was the Ping'an Stockade patrol office; there was also the Tangmu Stockade patrol office—four patrol offices, all later abolished.
195
潯州府元潯州路。 洪武元年爲府。 領縣三。 東北距布政司九百八十里。
Xunzhou Prefecture was the Yuan Xunzhou Route. In Hongwu 1 it became a prefecture. It governed three counties. It lay 980 li northeast of the Provincial Administration Commission.
196
桂平倚。 南有白石山。 西北有大藤峽。 北有黔江，一名北江，亦曰右江，南有鬱江，一名南江，亦曰左江，至城東匯爲潯江。 東北有武靖州，成化三年置，萬曆末廢。 又東有大黃江口、北有靖寧鄉、東北有大宣鄉、又有思隆鄉、又有木盤浦、西南有常林鄉六巡檢司。 又南有羅秀土巡檢司，又北有碧灘堡、鎮峽堡，俱成化中置。 東有牛屎灣堡，西有淹衝堡、秀江堡，俱嘉靖中置。
Guiping (seat-attached county). To the south is Baishi Mountain. To the northwest is the Great Vine Gorge. To the north is the Qian River, also called the Beijiang and the You River; to the south is the Yu River, also called the Nanjiang and the Zuo River—they converge east of the city to form the Xun River. To the northeast was Wujing Subprefecture, established in Chenghua 3 and abolished at the end of the Wanli reign. Farther east is the Dahuangjiangkou patrol office; to the north is the Jingning Township patrol office; to the northeast is the Daxuan Township patrol office; there are also the Silong Township, Mupanpu, and Changlin Township patrol offices—six in all. Farther south is the Luoxiu indigenous patrol office; to the north are Bitian Fort and Zhenxia Fort, both established during the Chenghua reign. To the east is Niushiwai Fort; to the west are Yanchong Fort and Xiujiang Fort—all established during the Jiajing reign.
197
平南府東。 東南有龔江，即潯江也，東有白馬江流入焉。 又有奉議衛，洪武二十八年八月置於奉議州，正統六年五月遷於此。 東北有大同、西北有泰川、西南有武林三巡檢司。 又南有峒心、東南有三堆、東北有大峽、西北有平嶺四土巡檢司。
Pingnan lies east of the prefecture. To the southeast is the Gong River—that is, the Xun River; from the east the Baima River flows into it. There is also the Fengyi Guard, established in the eighth month of Hongwu 28 at Fengyi Subprefecture and relocated here in the fifth month of Zhengtong 6. To the northeast is the Datong patrol office; to the northwest is the Taichuan patrol office; to the southwest is the Wulin patrol office. Farther south is the Dongxin indigenous patrol office; to the southeast is the Sandui indigenous patrol office; to the northeast is the Daxia indigenous patrol office; to the northwest is the Pingling indigenous patrol office.
198
貴府西。 元貴州，直隸廣西兩江道，洪武二年十月降爲縣，來屬。 南山在南。 又有東、西、北三山。 南有鬱江，亦曰南江，羣川悉流入焉。 有向武軍民千戶所，本向武守禦千戶所，洪武十八年十月置於向武州，三十年三月升軍民所，正統六年五月來遷縣北門外，萬曆二十三年又遷縣西北謝村鎮。 東南有新安寨、北有北山寨二巡檢司。 又南有橋頭墟、西有瓦塘渡、又有五州寨、又有東鋋渡、又有郭東里五巡檢司，廢。 又東南有三江城，萬曆中築。
Gui County lies west of the prefecture. Under the Yuan it was Gui Prefecture, directly subordinate to Guangxi's Liangjiang Circuit; in the tenth month of Hongwu 2 it was reduced to a county and came under Xunzhou Prefecture. Nanshan Mountain lies to the south. There are also mountains to the east, west, and north. To the south is the Yu River, also called the Nanjiang—all the streams flow into it. There is the Xiangwu Military-Civilian thousand-household post, originally the Xiangwu Garrison Defense thousand-household post, established in the tenth month of Hongwu 18 at Xiangwu Subprefecture; in the third month of Hongwu 30 it was promoted to a military-civilian post; in the fifth month of Zhengtong 6 it was relocated outside the county's north gate; in Wanli 23 it was moved again to Xiecun Town northwest of the county. To the southeast is the Xin'an Stockade patrol office; to the north is the Beishan Stockade patrol office. Farther south was the Qiaotou Market patrol office; to the west was the Watang Ferry patrol office; there were also the Wuzhou Stockade, Dongting Ferry, and Guodongli patrol offices—five patrol offices, all abolished. Farther southeast is Sanjiang City, built during the Wanli reign.
199
柳州府元柳州路。 洪武元年爲府。 領州二，縣十。 東北距布政司四百里。
Liuzhou Prefecture was the Yuan Liuzhou Route. In Hongwu 1 it became a prefecture. It governed two subprefectures and ten counties. It lay 400 li northeast of the Provincial Administration Commission.
200
馬平倚。 元爲府屬，洪武元年徙府治於此。 南有柳江，亦曰潯水，亦曰黔江，上流自貴州黎平府流入府境，下流至桂平縣合於鬱江，亦曰右江。 南有新興鎮、都博鎮二巡檢司。 又有歸化鎮巡檢司，廢。
Maping (seat-attached county). Under the Yuan it belonged to the prefecture; in Hongwu 1 the prefectural seat was moved here. To the south is the Liujiang, also called the Xun Water and the Qian River; its upper course enters the prefecture from Liping Prefecture in Guizhou; downstream at Guiping County it joins the Yu River, also called the You River. To the south are the Xinxing Town and Dubo Town patrol offices. There was also the Guihua Town patrol office, now abolished.
201
洛容府東北。 舊治白龍巖，天順中，徙於硃峒。 正德時，爲瑤、僮所據，嘉靖三年十一月復，萬曆四年正月遷於靈塘，以硃峒舊治爲平樂鎮，留兵百名守之。 城南有洛清江，至馬平縣入於柳江。 西南有江口鎮、又有運江二巡檢司。 東有平樂鎮巡檢司，治石榴江，後遷縣東北中渡。 又西南有章洛鎮巡檢司，廢。
Luorong lies northeast of the prefecture. The old seat was at Bailong Rock; during the Tianshun reign it was moved to Zhudong. During the Zhengde reign it was seized by Yao and Zhuang peoples; it was recovered in the eleventh month of Jiajing 3; in the first month of Wanli 4 the seat was moved to Lingtang, the former site at Zhudong was made Pingle Town, and a garrison of one hundred troops was left to hold it. South of the city is the Luoqing River, which at Maping County enters the Liujiang. To the southwest are the Jiangkou Town and Yunjiang patrol offices. To the east is the Pingle Town patrol office, originally at Shiliu River, later moved to Zhongdu northeast of the county. Farther southwest was the Zhangluo Town patrol office, now abolished.
202
柳城府西北。 舊治龍江南，元爲府治。 洪武元年遷治龍江東，而府徙治馬平縣。 龍江自天河縣流入，合於融江，即柳江上流。 東有東泉鎮巡檢司。 北有古枿鎮巡檢司，初治融江東岸，後遷馬頭驛。 又東北有古清鎮、西有洛好鎮、又有廖洞鎮三巡檢司。
Liucheng lies northwest of the prefecture. The old seat was south of the Longjiang; under the Yuan it was the prefectural seat. In Hongwu 1 the seat was moved to the east bank of the Longjiang, while the prefectural seat was transferred to Maping County. The Longjiang flows in from Tianhe County, joins the Rong River, and forms the upper course of the Liujiang. To the east is the Dongquan Town patrol office. To the north is the Guzhe Town patrol office, originally on the east bank of the Rong River, later moved to Matou Post. Farther northeast is the Guqing Town patrol office; to the west is the Luohao Town patrol office; there is also the Liaodong Town patrol office.
203
羅城府西北。 洪武二年十月以羅城鄉置，屬融州。 十年五月來屬。 北有武陽江，下流合於融江。 北有武陽鎮、又有莫離鎮、又有通道鎮三巡檢司。 又舊有安湘鎮、樂善鎮、中峒鎮三巡檢司，廢。
Luocheng lies northwest of the prefecture. In the tenth month of Hongwu 2 it was established from Luocheng Township, subordinate to Rong Prefecture. In the fifth month of Hongwu 10 it came under Liuzhou Prefecture. To the north is the Wuyang River, whose lower course joins the Rong River. To the north are the Wuyang Town, Moli Town, and Tongdao Town patrol offices. Formerly there were also the Anxiang Town, Leshan Town, and Zhongdong Town patrol offices, all abolished.
204
懷遠府北。 元屬融州。 洪武十年廢，置三江鎮巡檢司。 十三年十一月復置縣，來屬，治大融江、潯江之匯。 萬曆十九年移治丹陽鎮。 西北有九曲山，山南爲石門山，兩山夾峙。 福祿江自貴州永從縣流逕其中，至融縣爲融江，至柳城縣爲柳江。 又東北有潯江，自湖廣靖州流合焉，有潯江鎮巡檢司。 又西北有萬石鎮，又有宜良鎮、丹陽鎮三巡檢司。
Huaiyuan lies north of the prefecture. Under the Yuan it belonged to Rong Prefecture. It was abolished in Hongwu 10 and the Sanjiang Town patrol office was established in its place. In the eleventh month of Hongwu 13 the county was restored and came under Liuzhou Prefecture, seated at the confluence of the Darong River and Xun River. In Wanli 19 the seat was moved to Danyang Town. To the northwest are Jiujiu Mountain and, south of it, Shimen Mountain—the two peaks face each other across a narrow gap. The Fulu River flows through the gap from Yongcong County in Guizhou; at Rong County it becomes the Rong River, and at Liucheng County the Liujiang. Farther northeast is the Xun River, which flows in from Jing Prefecture in Huguang and joins there; there is the Xunjiang Town patrol office. Farther northwest is Wanshi Town; there are also the Yiliang Town and Danyang Town patrol offices.
205
融府西北。 元融州，直隸廣西兩江道。 洪武二年十月以州治融水縣省入，來屬。 十年五月降爲縣。 東南有靈巖山。 北有云際山。 其西曰上石門，以兩山夾峙，融江中流也。 又東有寶積山，產鐵。 東北有思管鎮、東南有清流鎮、西南有鵝頭隘三巡檢司。 又北有長安鎮巡檢司，本在融江東岸，後遷西岸。 又有大約鎮土巡檢司。 又有保江鎮、理源鎮、西峒鎮三巡檢司，廢。
Rong County lies northwest of the prefecture. Under the Yuan it was Rong Prefecture, directly subordinate to Guangxi's Liangjiang Circuit. In the tenth month of Hongwu 2 the seat-attached Rongshui County was abolished and merged in, and it came under Liuzhou Prefecture. In the fifth month of Hongwu 10 it was reduced to a county. To the southeast is Lingyan Mountain. To the north is Yunji Mountain. To its west is Upper Shimen, where two mountains face each other and the Rong River runs between them. Farther east is Baoji Mountain, which produces iron. To the northeast is the Siguan Town patrol office; to the southeast is the Qingliu Town patrol office; to the southwest is the Etou Pass patrol office. Farther north is the Chang'an Town patrol office, originally on the east bank of the Rong River, later moved to the west bank. There is also the Dayue Town indigenous patrol office. There were also the Baojiang Town, Liyuan Town, and Xidong Town patrol offices, all abolished.
206
來賓府南。 元屬象州。 洪武十年五月來屬。 西南有白牛洞。 北有白雲洞。 南有大江，亦曰都泥江。 西有界牌鎮巡檢司，後遷縣南之南岡。
Laibin lies south of the prefecture. Under the Yuan it belonged to Xiang Prefecture. In the fifth month of Hongwu 10 it came under Liuzhou Prefecture. To the southwest is White Ox Cave. To the north is White Cloud Cave. To the south is the Great River, also called the Duni River. To the west is the Jiepai Town patrol office, later moved to Nangang south of the county.
207
象州元直隸廣西兩江道。 洪武二年十月來屬，以州治陽壽縣省入。 西有象山。 東有雷山。 南有象江，即柳江。 東北有龍門寨巡檢司。 又有鵝頸鎮、尖山鎮二巡檢司，廢。 西北距府百十三里，領縣一：
Xiang Prefecture: Under the Yuan it was directly subordinate to Guangxi's Liangjiang Circuit. In the tenth month of Hongwu 2 it came under Liuzhou Prefecture, and seat-attached Yangshou County was abolished and merged in. To the west is Elephant Mountain. To the east is Lei Mountain. To the south is the Xiang River, which is the Liu River. To the northeast is the Longmen Stockade patrol office. There were also the E'jing Town and Jianshan Town patrol offices, both later abolished. It lay 113 li northwest of the prefecture and governed one county:
208
武宣州南。 元曰武仙。 宣德六年更名。 舊治陰江。 宣德六年三月徙於高立。 東南有大藤峽，後名永通峽。 西有柳江，又有都泥江，亦謂之橫水江，來入焉，下流爲潯州府之右江，亦入於柳江。 西北有安永鎮、西南有縣郭鎮二巡檢司。 又東有東鄉、又有周衝、又有閒得三巡檢司，廢。
Wuxuan lies south of the prefecture. Under the Yuan it was called Wuxian. It was renamed in Xuande 6. The old seat was at Yinjiang. In the third month of Xuande 6 it was moved to Gaoli. To the southeast is the Great Rattan Gorge, later renamed Yongtong Gorge. To the west is the Liu River; the Duni River, also called the Hengshui River, flows in here, and downstream becomes the You River of Xun Prefecture before rejoining the Liu River. To the northwest is the Anyong Town patrol office; to the southwest is the Xianguo Town patrol office. Farther east were the Dongxiang, Zhouchong, and Xiande patrol offices, all later abolished.
209
賓州元直隸廣西兩江道。 洪武二年九月以州治領方縣省入。 十月來屬。 東南有鎮龍山。 西南有燈臺山。 西有古漏山，下有古漏關，古漏水出焉，入於賓水。 賓水在南，即都泥江也。 東有安城鎮巡檢司。 又東有樑村巡檢司，後廢。 北距府三百里。 領縣二：
Bin Prefecture: Under the Yuan it was directly subordinate to Guangxi's Liangjiang Circuit. In the ninth month of Hongwu 2 seat-attached Lingfang County was abolished and merged in. In the tenth month it came under Liuzhou Prefecture. To the southeast is Zhenlong Mountain. To the southwest is Lamp Stand Mountain. To the west is Gulu Mountain, below which lies Gulu Pass; Gulu Water rises there and flows into Bin Water. Bin Water lies to the south—it is the Duni River. To the east is the Ancheng Town patrol office. Farther east was the Liangcun patrol office, later abolished. It lay 300 li north of the prefecture. It governed two counties:
210
遷江州北。 西有古黨山，有峒。 東北有大江，即都泥江。 東有遷江屯田千戶所，洪武二十五年九月置。 東南有清水鎮巡檢司，又有羅目鎮、李廣鎮二巡檢司，廢。 又東有石零堡，北有都歷堡，俱正德中築。
Qianjiang lies north of the prefecture. To the west is Gudang Mountain, with cave settlements. To the northeast is the Great River, which is the Duni River. To the east is the Qianjiang garrison-farm thousand-household post, established in the ninth month of Hongwu 25. To the southeast is the Qingshui Town patrol office; the Luomu Town and Liguang Town patrol offices were later abolished. Farther east is Shiling Fort; to the north is Dulie Fort—both built during the Zhengde reign.
211
上林州西少北。 西有大明山，澄江出焉，亦名南江，東合北江，又東入遷江縣之大江。 西北有三里營，南丹衛在焉。 衛舊在南丹州，洪武二十八年八月置，二十九年正月升軍民指揮使司，尋罷軍民，止爲衛。 永樂二年十二月徙上林縣東，正統六年五月徙賓州城，與賓州千戶所同治，萬曆八年徙於此。 西南有周安堡，在八寨中，舊爲瑤、僮所據，嘉靖三年討平之，萬曆七年改屬南丹衛。 西北有三畔鎮巡檢司。 又東北有琴水橋、東南有思龍鎮、又有三門灘鎮三巡檢司。
Shanglin lies west and slightly north of the prefecture. To the west is Daming Mountain, whence the Cheng River rises—it is also called the South River; flowing east it joins the North River, then farther east enters the Great River in Qianjiang County. To the northwest is Sanli Camp, where Nandan Guard is stationed. The guard was originally at Nandan Prefecture, established in the eighth month of Hongwu 28; in the first month of Hongwu 29 it was promoted to a joint military-civilian command, but the civilian component was soon abolished and it remained a guard only. In the twelfth month of Yongle 2 it was moved east of Shanglin County; in the fifth month of Zhengtong 6 it was moved to Bin Prefecture city, sharing administration with the Bin thousand-household post; in Wanli 8 it was moved here. To the southwest is Zhou'an Fort, among the Eight Stockades, formerly held by Yao and Zhuang peoples; pacified in Jiajing 3 and transferred to Nandan Guard in Wanli 7. To the northwest is the Sanpan Town patrol office. Farther northeast is the Qinshui Bridge patrol office; to the southeast is the Silong Town patrol office; there is also the Sanmentan Town patrol office.
212
慶遠府元慶遠路。 洪武元年爲府。 二年正月改慶遠南丹軍民安撫司。 三年六月復曰慶遠府。 領州四，縣五，長官司三。 東北距布政司五百七十里。
Qingyuan Prefecture was the Yuan Qingyuan Route. In Hongwu 1 it became a prefecture. In the first month of Hongwu 2 it was changed to the Qingyuan-Nandan Joint Military-Civilian Pacification Commission. In the sixth month of Hongwu 3 it was restored as Qingyuan Prefecture. It governed four prefectures, five counties, and three native chieftaincies. It lay 570 li northeast of the Provincial Administration Commission.
213
宜山倚。 北有龍江，東流入融縣，合於融江。 西有河池守禦千戶所，洪武二十八年十月置於河池縣，永樂六年徙於此。 東有大曹鎮、西有懷遠鎮、又有德勝鎮、又有東江鎮四巡檢司。
Yishan (seat-attached county). To the north is the Long River, which flows east into Rong County and joins the Rong River. To the west is the Hechi garrison defense thousand-household post, established in Hechi County in the tenth month of Hongwu 28 and moved here in Yongle 6. To the east is the Dacao Town patrol office; to the west is the Huaiyuan Town patrol office; there are also the Desheng and Dongjiang town patrol offices.
214
天河府北少東。 舊縣在高寨。 洪武二年遷於蘭石。 正統七年又遷甘場。 嘉靖十三年又遷福祿鎮。 萬曆十九年始移今治。 西南有龍江，自貴州獨山州流入。 北有東禪鎮巡檢司，又有思農鎮、歸仁鎮二土巡檢司。
Tianhe lies north and slightly east of the prefecture. The old county seat was at Gaozhai. In Hongwu 2 it was moved to Lanshi. In Zhengtong 7 it was moved again to Ganchang. In Jiajing 13 it was moved again to Fulu Town. In Wanli 19 it was moved to the present seat. To the southwest is the Long River, flowing in from Dushan Prefecture in Guizhou. To the north is the Dongchan Town patrol office; there are also the Sinong Town and Guiren Town indigenous patrol offices.
215
忻城府南少東。 西有烏泥江，即都泥江。 北有三寨堡土巡檢司。
Xin lies south and slightly east of the prefecture. To the west is the Wuni River, which is the Duni River. To the north is the San Zhaibao indigenous patrol office.
216
河池州元河池縣。 弘治十七年五月升爲州。 縣舊治在州北懷德故城。 天順六年遷屏風山。 成化十三年還治懷德。 嘉靖四年又遷鳳儀山南。 西有智州山。 東有金城江，下流合於都泥江。 江北有金城鎮巡檢司。 又東有都銘鎮、土堡鎮二巡檢司，後廢。 東距府二百五十里。 領縣二：
Hechi Prefecture was Hechi County under the Yuan. In the fifth month of Hongzhi 17 it was promoted to a prefecture. The old county seat was at the former Huai'en city north of the prefecture. In Tianshun 6 it was moved to Pingfeng Mountain. In Chenghua 13 it returned to Huai'en. In Jiajing 4 it was moved again to the south of Fengyi Mountain. To the west is Zhizhou Mountain. To the east is the Jincheng River, whose lower course joins the Duni River. North of the river is the Jincheng Town patrol office. Farther east were the Duming Town and Tubao Town patrol offices, later abolished. It lay 250 li east of the prefecture. It governed two counties:
217
思恩州東北。 舊屬府，正德元年二月改屬州。 舊治在環江洲。 永樂末，遷於清潭村。 宣德三年十一月遷於白山寨。 成化八年遷於歐家山。 南有環江，北有帶溪，皆合流於龍江。 有安化鎮、歸思鎮二巡檢司。 又有普義鎮、吉安鎮、北蘭鎮三巡檢司，廢。
Si'en lies northeast of the prefecture. Formerly subordinate to the prefecture; in the second month of Zhengde 1 it was transferred to Hechi Prefecture. The old seat was at Huanjiang Isle. At the end of the Yongle reign it was moved to Qingtan Village. In the eleventh month of Xuande 3 it was moved to Baishan Stockade. In Chenghua 8 it was moved to Oujia Mountain. To the south is the Huan River; to the north is the Dai Stream—both unite in the Long River. There are the Anhua Town and Guisi Town patrol offices. There were also the Puyi, Ji'an, and Beilan town patrol offices, all later abolished.
218
南丹州洪武七年七月置。 二十八年廢，尋復置。 西有孟英山，舊產銀。 南有都泥江，自貴州定番州流入。 東距府二百四十里。
Nandan Prefecture was established in the seventh month of Hongwu 7. It was abolished in Hongwu 28 but soon restored. To the west is Mengying Mountain, which once produced silver. To the south is the Duni River, flowing in from Dingfan Prefecture in Guizhou. It lay 240 li east of the prefecture.
219
東蘭州洪武十二年置。 以西蘭州省入，又省安習、忠、文三州入焉。 東南有隘洞江，一名都泥江，又名紅水河，又名烏泥江。 東北距府四百二十里。
Donglan Prefecture was established in Hongwu 12. Xilan Prefecture was abolished and merged in, as were the three prefectures of Anxi, Zhong, and Wen. To the southeast is the Aidong River, also called the Duni River, the Red Water River, and the Wuni River. It lay 420 li northeast of the prefecture.
220
那地州元地州。 洪武元年改置。 北有都泥江，有布柳水流合焉。 南有那州，洪武元年省。 東北距府二百四十里。
Nadi Prefecture was Di Prefecture under the Yuan. It was reestablished in Hongwu 1. To the north is the Duni River, into which the Buliu Stream flows. To the south once stood Na Prefecture, abolished in Hongwu 1. It lay 240 li northeast of the prefecture.
221
永順長官司府西南。
Yongshun Native Chieftaincy lies southwest of the prefecture.
222
永定長官司府南。 二司皆弘治五年析宜山縣地置。
Yongding Native Chieftaincy lies south of the prefecture. Both offices were established in Hongzhi 5 from territory carved out of Yishan County.
223
永安長官司弘治九年九月析天河縣十八里地置。
Yong'an Native Chieftaincy was established in the ninth month of Hongzhi 9 from eighteen li of territory carved out of Tianhe County.
224
南寧府元南寧路。 洪武元年爲府。 領州七，縣三。 東北距布政司千二百里。
Nanning Prefecture was the Yuan Nanning Route. In Hongwu 1 it became a prefecture. It governed seven prefectures and three counties. It lay 1,200 li northeast of the Provincial Administration Commission.
225
宣化倚。 東有崑崙山，上有崑崙關。 又有橫山，又有思玉山。 北有馬退山。 東南有望仙坡，與青、羅二山相對。 城西南有大江，即鬱江，一曰夜郎豚水。 其上流有二：一爲南盤江，經府城南，曰右江； 一爲麗江，經府城西南，曰左江。 合流處謂之合江鎮，下流爲潯州府之左江。 東有金城寨、西有那南寨、又有那龍寨、又有遷隆寨、南有八尺寨五巡檢司。
Xuanhua (seat-attached county). To the east is Kunlun Mountain, atop which stands Kunlun Pass. There is also Heng Mountain and Siyu Mountain. To the north is Matui Mountain. To the southeast is Wangxian Slope, facing the two mountains Qing and Luo across the way. Southwest of the city is the Great River—the Yu River, also known as Yelang Tun Water. Its upper course divides in two: one is the Nanpan River, which passes south of the prefectural city and is called the Right River; the other is the Lijiang, which passes southwest of the prefectural city and is called the Left River. Where they meet is called Hejiang Town; downstream it becomes the Left River of Xun Prefecture. To the east is Jincheng Stockade; to the west is Nanan Stockade; there is also Nalong Stockade and Qianlong Stockade; to the south is Bachai Stockade—five patrol offices.
226
隆安府西北。 嘉靖十二年四月析宣化縣那久地置。 東有火焰山。 城北有盤江，亦曰右江。 西南有那樓寨、西北有馱演寨二巡檢司。
Long'an Prefecture lies northwest of the prefecture. In the fourth month of Jiajing 12 it was established from the Najiu district of Xuanhua County. To the east is Flame Mountain. North of the city is the Pan River, also called the Right River. To the southwest is the Nalou Stockade patrol office; to the northwest is the Tuoyan Stockade patrol office.
227
橫州元直隸廣西兩江道。 洪武二年九月以州治寧浦縣省入，屬潯州府。 十年五月降爲縣，來屬。 十三年十一月復爲州，仍置寧浦縣爲州治，縣尋廢。 東有烏蠻山。 南有鬱江，又東南有武流江，源自廣東靈山縣，流入境合焉。 東有古江口、西有南鄉二巡檢司。 又南有太平關，成化四年置。 西北距府二百四十里。 領縣一：
Heng Prefecture was directly subordinate to Guangxi's Liangjiang Circuit under the Yuan. In the ninth month of Hongwu 2 the seat-attached Ningpu County was abolished and merged in, and the prefecture came under Xun Prefecture. In the fifth month of Hongwu 10 it was reduced to a county and came under Nanning Prefecture. In the eleventh month of Hongwu 13 it was restored as a prefecture, with Ningpu County again established as the seat county; the county was soon abolished. To the east is Wuman Mountain. To the south is the Yu River; from the southeast the Wuliu River, rising in Lingshan County in Guangdong, flows into the prefecture and joins it. To the east is the Gujiangkou patrol office; to the west is the Nanxiang patrol office. Farther south is Taiping Pass, established in Chenghua 4. It lay 240 li northwest of the prefecture. It governed one county:
228
永淳州西。 元屬橫州。 洪武十年五月省入橫縣。 十三年十一月復置，屬州。 西臨鬱江。 南有南里鄉、北有武羅鄉二巡檢司。 又東北有修德鄉巡檢司，景泰間遷於縣西，後廢。
Yongchun Prefecture lies west of the prefecture. Under the Yuan it belonged to Heng Prefecture. In the fifth month of Hongwu 10 it was abolished and merged into Heng County. In the eleventh month of Hongwu 13 it was restored and placed under the prefecture. Its western border lies on the Yu River. To the south is the Nanli Township patrol office; to the north is the Wuluo Township patrol office. Farther northeast was the Xiude Township patrol office, moved west of the county during the Jingtai reign and later abolished.
229
新寧州隆慶六年二月以宣化縣定祿洞地置。 北有三峯山。 城西有麗江，一名定祿江，又名文字水。 東南有渠樂寨巡檢司。 東距府二百里。
Xinning Prefecture was established in the second month of Longqing 6 from the Dinglu Cave district of Xuanhua County. To the north is Sanfeng Mountain. West of the city is the Lijiang, also called the Dinglu River and also known as Wenzishui. To the southeast is the Qule Stockade patrol office. It lay 200 li east of the prefecture.
230
上思州元屬思明路。 洪武初廢。 二十一年正月復置，屬思明府。 弘治十八年來屬。 南有十萬山，上思江出焉，東流合西小江，西即交址所出之左江也。 又有明江，亦出十萬山，西流入思明府界。 又西有遷隆峒土巡檢司。 東南距府三百里。
Shangsi Prefecture was subordinate to Siming Route under the Yuan. It was abolished at the beginning of the Hongwu reign. In the first month of Hongwu 21 it was restored and placed under Siming Prefecture. In Hongzhi 18 it came under Nanning Prefecture. To the south is Shiwan Mountain, from which the Shangsi River rises; flowing east it joins the West Little River—the western branch being the Left River that issues from Annam. There is also the Ming River, which likewise rises from Shiwan Mountain and flows west into Siming Prefecture. Farther west is the Qianlong Cave indigenous patrol office. It lay 300 li southeast of the prefecture.
231
歸德州元屬田州路。 洪武二年屬田州府。 弘治十八年來屬。 鬱江在西南。 東南距府三百五十里。
Guide Prefecture belonged to Tian Prefecture Route under the Yuan. In Hongwu 2 it belonged to Tian Prefecture. In Hongzhi 18 it came under Nanning Prefecture. The Yu River lies to the southwest. It lay 350 li southeast of the prefecture.
232
果化州元屬田州路。 洪武二年屬田州府。 嘉靖九年十二月來屬。 南盤江在西。 東南距府三百二十里。
Guohua Prefecture belonged to Tian Prefecture Route under the Yuan. In Hongwu 2 it belonged to Tian Prefecture. In the twelfth month of Jiajing 9 it came under Nanning Prefecture. The Nanpan River lies to the west. It lay 320 li southeast of the prefecture.
233
忠州元屬思明路。 洪武初廢。 二十一年正月復置，屬思明府。 萬曆三年九月來屬。 東北距府四百餘里。
Zhong Prefecture was subordinate to Siming Route under the Yuan. It was abolished at the beginning of the Hongwu reign. In the first month of Hongwu 21 it was restored and placed under Siming Prefecture. In the ninth month of Wanli 3 it came under Nanning Prefecture. It lay over 400 li northeast of the prefecture.
234
下雷州元下雷峒。 洪武初，屬鎮安府。 嘉靖四十三年來屬。 萬曆十八年升爲州。 南有邏水，自鎮安府流入，南寧府左江之別源也。 東距府五百八十里。
Xialei Prefecture was Xialei Cave under the Yuan. At the beginning of the Hongwu reign it belonged to Zhen'an Prefecture. In Jiajing 43 it came under Nanning Prefecture. In Wanli 18 it was promoted to prefecture status. To the south is the Luo Water, flowing in from Zhen'an Prefecture—a separate source of Nanning Prefecture's Left River. It lay 580 li east of the prefecture.
235
思恩軍民府元思恩州，屬田州路。 洪武二年屬田州府，後屬雲南廣西府。 永樂二年八月直隸廣西布政司。 正統四年十月升爲府。 六年十一月升軍民府。 舊治在府西北。 正統七年遷府東北之喬利。 嘉靖七年七月又遷武緣縣止戈裏之荒田驛，因割止戈二里屬之。 西北有都陽山。 東南有靖遠峯。 北有紅水江，又有馱蒙江，一名清水江，流合焉。 又有大攬江，出城東北大名山，下流俱入於鬱江。 東有鳳化縣，正德六年七月置，嘉靖八年十月廢。 東有古零，西有定羅、那馬、下旺，北有興隆，東北有白山、安定，西北有舊城、都陽九土巡檢司。 領州二，縣二。 東北距布政司千二百里。
Si'en Military-Civilian Prefecture was Si'en Prefecture under the Yuan, belonging to Tian Prefecture Route. In Hongwu 2 it belonged to Tian Prefecture; later it was transferred to Yunnan's Guangxi Prefecture. In the eighth month of Yongle 2 it was placed directly under the Guangxi Provincial Administration Commission. In the tenth month of Zhengtong 4 it was promoted to prefecture status. In the eleventh month of Zhengtong 6 it was elevated to a military-civilian prefecture. The old seat lay northwest of the prefecture. In Zhengtong 7 the seat was moved to Qiaoli, northeast of the former location. In the seventh month of Jiajing 7 it was moved again to Huangtian Post in Zhige Village, Wuyuan County, with two li of Zhige carved out and placed under it. To the northwest is Duyang Mountain. To the southeast is Jingyuan Peak. To the north is the Hongshui River; the Tuomeng River, also called the Qingshui River, flows into it here. There is also the Dalan River, rising from Daming Mountain northeast of the city; all flow down into the Yu River. To the east was Fenghua County, established in the seventh month of Zhengde 6 and abolished in the tenth month of Jiajing 8. To the east is Guling; to the west are Dingluo, Nama, and Xiwang; to the north is Xinglong; to the northeast are Baishan and Anding; to the northwest are Jiucheng and Duyang—nine indigenous patrol offices. It governed two prefectures and two counties. It lay 1,200 li northeast of the Provincial Administration Commission.
236
奉議州元直隸廣西兩江道。 洪武五年省入來安府。 七年二月復置，直隸行省。 二十八年復廢，尋復置，直隸布政司。 嘉靖六年二月來屬。 東有舊城。 今治本砦林村也，洪武初，遷於此。 北濱南盤江，有州門渡。 距府百十里。
Fengyi Prefecture was directly subordinate to Guangxi's Liangjiang Circuit under the Yuan. In Hongwu 5 it was abolished and merged into Lai'an Prefecture. In the second month of Hongwu 7 it was restored and placed directly under the Branch Secretariat. In Hongwu 28 it was abolished again, soon restored, and placed directly under the Provincial Administration Commission. In the second month of Jiajing 6 it came under Si'en Military-Civilian Prefecture. To the east is the Old City. The present seat is at Zhaiblin Village; at the beginning of the Hongwu reign it was moved here. To the north it borders the Nanpan River; there is the Zhoumen Ford. It lay 110 li from the prefecture.
237
上映州元屬鎮安路。 洪武五年廢爲洞。 萬曆三十二年復置，來屬。 東北距府四百七十里。
Shangying Prefecture under the Yuan belonged to Zhen'an Route. In Hongwu 5 it was abolished and reduced to a native domain. In Wanli 32 it was restored and came under Si'en Prefecture. It lay 470 li northeast of the prefecture.
238
上林府西南。 元屬田州路。 洪武二年屬田州府。 嘉靖七年七月來屬。 北有南盤江，南有大羅溪，東流合焉，即枯榕江之下流也。
Shanglin lies southwest of the prefecture. Under the Yuan it belonged to Tianzhou Route. In Hongwu 2 it came under Tianzhou Prefecture. In the seventh month of Jiajing 7 it came under Si'en Prefecture. To the north is the Nanpan River; to the south is the Daluo Creek, which flows east to join it—the lower course of the Kurong River.
239
武緣府南。 元屬南寧路。 萬曆五年十月來屬。 西有西江，即大欖江也，東南有南流江合焉。 東有鏌鎁寨、又有博澀寨、西有高井寨、西北有西舍寨四巡檢司。 又南有橫山寨巡檢司，廢。
Wuyuan lies south of the prefecture. Under the Yuan it belonged to Nanning Route. In the tenth month of Wanli 5 it came under Si'en Prefecture. To the west is the Xi River, which is the Dalang River; from the southeast the Nanliu River joins it. To the east is the Moyu Stockade patrol office; there is also the Bose Stockade patrol office; to the west is the Gaojing Stockade patrol office; to the northwest is the Xishe Stockade patrol office—four patrol offices in all. Farther south was the Hengshan Stockade patrol office—now abolished.
240
太平府元太平路，至元二十九年閏六月置。 洪武二年七月爲府。 領州十七，縣三。 東北距布政司二千五十里。
Taiping Prefecture was the Yuan Taiping Route, established in the intercalary sixth month of Zhiyuan 29. In the seventh month of Hongwu 2 it became a prefecture. It governed seventeen prefectures and three counties. It lay 2,050 li northeast of the Provincial Administration Commission.
241
崇善倚。 府治馱盧村，洪武二年徙治麗江。 舊縣治在府西北，嘉靖十九年遷入郭內。 北有青連山。 東有將軍山，下有威震關，一名伏波關。 南有府前江，即麗江，又西有邏水流入焉。 北有壺關，正德三年置。 又東北有保障關。
Chongshan (seat-attached county). The prefectural seat was at Tuolu Village; in Hongwu 2 it was moved to Lijiang. The old county seat lay northwest of the prefecture; in Jiajing 19 it was moved inside the walled city. To the north is Qinglian Mountain. To the east is General Mountain; below it is Weizhen Pass, also called Fubo Pass. To the south is the river before the prefectural seat—the Lijiang; from the west the Luo River also flows in. To the north is Hu Pass, established in Zhengde 3. Farther northeast is Baozhang Pass.
242
陀陵府東北。 東有淥空山，淥空江出焉，亦名綠甕江。 又南有麗江。
Tuoling lies northeast of the prefecture. To the east is Lukong Mountain, where the Lukong River rises—also called the Lüweng River. Farther south is the Lijiang.
243
羅陽府東北。 南有麗江。 西有馱排江，源出永康縣，下流入於麗江。 以上三縣，元俱屬太平路。
Luoyang lies northeast of the prefecture. To the south is the Lijiang. To the west is the Tuopai River, which rises in Yongkang County and flows down into the Lijiang. All three counties above under the Yuan belonged to Taiping Route.
244
左州東有舊治。 成化十三年遷於思崖村。 正德十五年遷於今治，本古攬村也。 西北有金山。 南有麗江。 西南距府百里。
Zuozhou had its old seat to the east. In Chenghua 13 it was moved to Siya Village. In Zhengde 15 it was moved to the present seat—the former Gulian Village. To the northwest is Jin Mountain. To the south is the Lijiang. It lay 100 li southwest of the prefecture.
245
養利州有舊州三，一在州北，一在西北，一在東北。 又西北有養水。 北有通利江，至崇善縣注於麗江。 以上二州，元屬太平路。 南距府百五十里。
Yangli Prefecture had three former seats—one north of the prefecture, one to the northwest, and one to the northeast. Farther northwest is Yang Water. To the north is the Tongli River, which at Chongshan County empties into the Lijiang. Both prefectures above under the Yuan belonged to Taiping Route. It lay 150 li south of the prefecture.
246
永康州元永康縣，屬太平路。 萬曆二十八年六月升爲州。 北有故城。 萬曆中遷於今治。 西有綠甕江，下流亦合麗江焉。 西南有思同州，舊屬府。 萬曆二十八年六月省。 西南距府二百里。
Yongkang Prefecture was Yongkang County under the Yuan, belonging to Taiping Route. In the sixth month of Wanli 28 it was elevated to a prefecture. To the north is the old walled city. During the Wanli reign it was moved to the present seat. To the west is the Lüweng River, whose lower course also joins the Lijiang. To the southwest is Sitong Prefecture, formerly belonging to the prefecture. In the sixth month of Wanli 28 it was abolished. It lay 200 li southwest of the prefecture.
247
上石西州元屬思明路。 洪武末省。 永樂二年復置。 萬曆三十八年來屬。 東有明江，西北流入麗江。 東北距府三百三十里。
Shangshixi Prefecture under the Yuan belonged to Siming Route. It was abolished at the end of the Hongwu reign. It was restored in Yongle 2. In Wanli 38 it came under Taiping Prefecture. To the east is the Ming River, which flows northwest into the Lijiang. It lay 330 li northeast of the prefecture.
248
太平州自此以下十一州，元屬太平路。 邏水在西，下流入麗江。 東南距府八十里。
From Taiping Prefecture below, the eleven prefectures under the Yuan belonged to Taiping Route. The Luo River lies to the west; its lower course flows into the Lijiang. It lay 80 li southeast of the prefecture.
249
思城州南有教水，下流合於隴水。 東南距府五百里。
Sicheng Prefecture has Jiao Water to the south; its lower course joins Long Water. It lay 500 li southeast of the prefecture.
250
安平州南有隴水，下流合於邏水。 東南距府百十里。
Anping Prefecture has Long Water to the south; its lower course joins the Luo River. It lay 110 li southeast of the prefecture.
251
萬承州西南有綠降水，亦名玉帶水。 西南距府五十里。
Wancheng Prefecture has Lüjiang Water to the southwest, also called Yudai Water. It lay 50 li southwest of the prefecture.
252
全茗州西有通利江，一名大利江。 南距府百六十里。
Quanming Prefecture has the Tongli River to the west, also called the Dali River. It lay 160 li south of the prefecture.
253
鎮遠州北有楊山。 南有巖磨水。 西南距府二百八十里。
Zhenyuan Prefecture has Yang Mountain to the north. To the south is Yanmo Water. It lay 280 li southwest of the prefecture.
254
茗盈州南有觀音巖，澗水出焉，下流入於麗江。 西南距府六十里。
Mingying Prefecture has Guanyin Cliff to the south; a stream rises there and flows down into the Lijiang. It lay 60 li southwest of the prefecture.
255
龍英州南有通利江，有三源，下流入於麗江。 南距府二百十里。
Longying Prefecture has the Tongli River to the south with three sources; it flows down into the Lijiang. It lay 210 li south of the prefecture.
256
結安州西有堰水，下流入麗江。 西南距府二百二十里。
Jie'an Prefecture has Yan Water to the west; its lower course flows into the Lijiang. It lay 220 li southwest of the prefecture.
257
結倫州南有咘畢水。 即堰水之上流。 西南距府三百三十里。
Jielun Prefecture has Bubi Water to the south. It is the upper course of Yan Water. It lay 330 li southwest of the prefecture.
258
都結州南有咘畢水。 西南距府三百三十里。
Dujie Prefecture has Bubi Water to the south. It lay 330 li southwest of the prefecture.
259
上下凍州元屬龍州萬戶府。 洪武初來屬。 西有八峯山，太源水出焉。 又北有青連山。 南有拱天嶺。 東距府二百二十里。
Shangxiadong Prefecture under the Yuan belonged to Longzhou Wanhu Command. At the beginning of the Hongwu reign it came under Taiping Prefecture. To the west is Bafeng Mountain, where Taiyuan Water rises. Farther north is Qinglian Mountain. To the south is Gongtian Ridge. It lay 220 li east of the prefecture.
260
思明州元屬思明路。 洪武二年屬思明府。 萬曆十六年三月來屬。 東有逐象山。 東北有明江，自思明府流入。 東北距府二百十里。
Siming Prefecture under the Yuan belonged to Siming Route. In Hongwu 2 it came under Siming Prefecture. In the third month of Wanli 16 it came under Taiping Prefecture. To the east is Zhuxiang Mountain. To the northeast is the Ming River, flowing in from Siming Prefecture. It lay 210 li northeast of the prefecture.
261
思明府元思明路。 洪武二年七月爲府，直隸行省。 九年直隸布政司。 南有明江，有永平寨巡檢司。 領州三。 北距布政司二千二百里。
Siming Prefecture was the Yuan Siming Route. In the seventh month of Hongwu 2 it became a prefecture, directly subordinate to the provincial administration. In Hongwu 9 it came under the Provincial Administration Commission directly. To the south is the Ming River; there is the Yongping Stockade patrol office. It governed three prefectures. It lay 2,200 li north of the Provincial Administration Commission.
262
下石西州元屬思明路。 洪武二年屬府。 舊治在東南。 萬曆間，始遷今治。 西距府百四十里。
Xiashixi Prefecture under the Yuan belonged to Siming Route. In Hongwu 2 it came under Siming Prefecture. The former seat was in the southeast. During the Wanli reign it was first moved to the present seat. It lay 140 li west of the prefecture.
263
西平州元屬思明路。 洪武三年省。 永樂二年復置。 宣德元年與安南。
Xiping Prefecture under the Yuan belonged to Siming Route. It was abolished in Hongwu 3. It was restored in Yongle 2. In Xuande 1 it passed to Annam.
264
祿州元屬思明府。 洪武三年省。 二十一年正月復置，尋沒於交址。 永樂三年收復。 宣德元年與安南。
Lu Prefecture under the Yuan belonged to Siming Prefecture. It was abolished in Hongwu 3. In the first month of Hongwu 21 it was restored, but was soon lost to Jiaozhi. It was recovered in Yongle 3. In Xuande 1 it passed to Annam.
265
鎮安府元鎮安路。 洪武二年爲府。 西有鎮安舊城。 洪武二年徙於廢凍州，即今治也。 南有馱命江，下流合鬱江。 又有邏水，發源府北土山峽中，下流至胡潤寨，與歸順州之邏水合，有湖潤寨巡檢司。 距布政司二千二百里。
Zhen'an Prefecture was the Yuan Zhen'an Route. In Hongwu 2 it became a prefecture. To the west is the old walled city of Zhen'an. In Hongwu 2 it was moved to the abandoned Dong Prefecture—the present seat. To the south is the Tuoming River, whose lower course joins the Yu River. There is also the Luo River, rising in a gorge among the earthen hills north of the prefecture; flowing down to Hurun Stockade it joins the Luo River of Guishun Prefecture, where the Hurun Stockade patrol office stands. It lay 2,200 li from the Provincial Administration Commission.
266
田州元田州路。 洪武二年七月爲府。 嘉靖七年六月降爲州，徙治八甲，而置田寧府於府城。 八年十月，府廢，州復還故治，直隸布政司。 東南有南盤江。 西有來安路，元屬廣西兩江道，洪武二年七月爲府，領歸仁州、羅博州、田州，十七年復廢。 北有上隆州，元屬田州路，洪武二年屬府，成化三年徙治潯州府東北，更名武靖州。 又有恩城州，元屬路，洪武初屬府，弘治五年廢。 東有牀甲、拱甲、婪鳳，西有武隆、累彩，北有岜馬甲、篆甲，東北有下隆，東南有砦桑，西北有凌時，西南有萬岡陽院，又有大甲、子甲，又有縣甲、怕河、怕牙、思郎、思幼、候周十九土巡檢司。 距布政司千六百里。
Tian Prefecture was the Yuan Tianzhou Route. In the seventh month of Hongwu 2 it became a prefecture. In the sixth month of Jiajing 7 it was reduced to a prefecture and its seat moved to Bajia, while Tianning Prefecture was established in the former prefectural city. In the tenth month of Jiajing 8 Tianning Prefecture was abolished; Tian Prefecture returned to its former seat and came directly under the Provincial Administration Commission. To the southeast is the Nanpan River. To the west is Laian Route, which under the Yuan belonged to Guangxi's Liangjiang Circuit; in the seventh month of Hongwu 2 it became a prefecture governing Guiren, Luobo, and Tian prefectures, and was abolished again in Hongwu 17. To the north is Shanglong Prefecture, which under the Yuan belonged to Tianzhou Route; in Hongwu 2 it came under Tian Prefecture, and in Chenghua 3 its seat was moved to the northeast of Xun Prefecture and it was renamed Wujing Prefecture. There was also Encheng Prefecture, which under the Yuan belonged to the route and in the early Hongwu reign came under Tian Prefecture; it was abolished in Hongzhi 5. To the east are the Chuangjia, Gongjia, and Lanfeng native districts; to the west are Wulong and Leicai; to the north are Bamajia and Zhuanjia; to the northeast is Xialong; to the southeast is Zhaisang; to the northwest is Lingshi; to the southwest is the Wangangyang Stockade; there are also Dajia and Zijia, and nineteen native patrol offices at Xianjia, Pahe, Payai, Silang, Siyou, and Houzhou. It lay 1,600 li from the Provincial Administration Commission.
267
歸順州元屬鎮安路。 洪武初，廢爲洞。 弘治九年八月復置，屬鎮安府。 嘉靖初，直隸布政司。 東北有龍潭水，南入交址高平府界。 又南有邏水，發源西北鵝槽隘界。 距布政司二千三百二十里。
Guishun Prefecture under the Yuan belonged to Zhen'an Route. At the beginning of the Hongwu reign it was abolished and reduced to a native domain. In the eighth month of Hongzhi 9 it was restored and placed under Zhen'an Prefecture. At the beginning of the Jiajing reign it came directly under the Provincial Administration Commission. To the northeast is Longtan Water, which flows south into the border of Gaoping Prefecture in Jiaozhi. Farther south is the Luo River, which rises on the border at Goose Trough Pass to the northwest. It lay 2,320 li from the Provincial Administration Commission.
268
泗城州元屬田州路。 洪武七年直隸行中書省。 九年直隸布政司。 舊州在西南，洪武六年移於古勘洞。 西有南盤江，自貴州慕役長官司流入，下流爲南寧府之右江。 又北有紅水江。 東北有程縣，洪武二十一年以泗城州之程醜莊置，屬州，尋屬慶遠府，宣德初，還屬州，嘉靖元年廢。 西南有利州，元屬田州路，洪武七年十一月直隸布政司，正統六年五月徙治泗城州古那甲，嘉靖二年廢。 又西有上林長官司，永樂七年以州之上林洞置，直隸布政司，萬曆中，省入州，崇禎六年分司西地入雲南廣南府。 有羅博關巡檢司。 北距布政司一千八百一十五里。
Sicheng Prefecture under the Yuan belonged to Tianzhou Route. In Hongwu 7 it came directly under the Branch Secretariat. In Hongwu 9 it came directly under the Provincial Administration Commission. The former seat lay in the southwest; in Hongwu 6 it was moved to Gukan Cave. To the west is the Nanpan River, flowing in from the Muyi Native Official Office in Guizhou; its lower course becomes the You River of Nanning Prefecture. Farther north is the Red Water River. To the northeast is Cheng County, established in Hongwu 21 from Chengchou Manor in Sicheng Prefecture and first attached to the prefecture, then transferred to Qingyuan Prefecture, returned to Sicheng in the Xuande reign, and abolished in Jiajing 1. To the southwest is Lizhou, which under the Yuan belonged to Tianzhou Route; in the eleventh month of Hongwu 7 it came directly under the Provincial Administration Commission, in the fifth month of Zhengtong 6 its seat was moved to Guna Stockade in Sicheng Prefecture, and it was abolished in Jiajing 2. Farther west is the Shanglin Native Official Office, established in Yongle 7 from Shanglin Cave in the prefecture and placed directly under the Provincial Administration Commission; during the Wanli reign it was merged into the prefecture, and in Chongzhen 6 its western territory was divided off into Yunnan's Guangnan Prefecture. There is the Luobo Pass patrol office. It lay 1,815 li north of the Provincial Administration Commission.
269
向武州元屬田州路。 洪武二年七月屬田州府。 二十八年廢。 建文二年復置，直隸布政司。 舊州在東。 萬曆四十五年遷於乃甲。 南有枯榕江，下流入於右江。 北有富勞縣，元屬田州路，洪武二年屬田州府，尋爲夷僚所據，建文四年復置，後廢。 東有武林縣，元亦屬田州路，洪武二年屬田州府，永樂初省入富勞縣。 距布政司二千四百里。
Xiangwu Prefecture under the Yuan belonged to Tianzhou Route. In the seventh month of Hongwu 2 it came under Tian Prefecture. It was abolished in Hongwu 28. It was restored in Jianwen 2 and came directly under the Provincial Administration Commission. The former seat lay in the east. In Wanli 45 it was moved to Naijia. To the south is the Kurong River, whose lower course flows into the You River. To the north is Fulao County, which under the Yuan belonged to Tianzhou Route and in Hongwu 2 came under Tian Prefecture; it was soon seized by tribal peoples, restored in Jianwen 4, and later abolished. To the east is Wulin County, which likewise under the Yuan belonged to Tianzhou Route and in Hongwu 2 came under Tian Prefecture; at the beginning of the Yongle reign it was merged into Fulao County. It lay 2,400 li from the Provincial Administration Commission.
270
都康州元屬田州路。 洪武二年屬田州府，後爲夷僚所據。 建文元年復置，直隸布政司。 西有岜爐江，下流合於通利江。 距布政司二千五百四十里。
Dukang Prefecture under the Yuan belonged to Tianzhou Route. In Hongwu 2 it came under Tian Prefecture, but was later seized by tribal peoples. It was restored in Jianwen 1 and came directly under the Provincial Administration Commission. To the west is the Balu River, whose lower course joins the Tongli River. It lay 2,540 li from the Provincial Administration Commission.
271
龍州元龍州萬戶府。 洪武二年七月仍爲州，屬太平府。 九年六月直隸布政司。 南有龍江，自交址廣源州流入，即麗江也，有明江流入焉，下流爲南寧府之左江。 距布政司二千三百里。
Long Prefecture was the Yuan Longzhou Wanhu Command. In the seventh month of Hongwu 2 it remained a prefecture and came under Taiping Prefecture. In the sixth month of Hongwu 9 it came directly under the Provincial Administration Commission. To the south is the Long River, flowing in from Guangyuan Prefecture in Jiaozhi—it is the Lijiang; the Ming River also flows into it, and its lower course becomes the Zuo River of Nanning Prefecture. It lay 2,300 li from the Provincial Administration Commission.
272
江州元屬思明路。 洪武二十年直隸布政司。 東有歸安水，西有綠眉水，下流俱合於麗江。 領縣一。 距布政司二千一百十里。
Jiang Prefecture under the Yuan belonged to Siming Route. In Hongwu 20 it came directly under the Provincial Administration Commission. To the east is Gui'an Water; to the west is Lümei Water; both flow down to join the Lijiang. It governed one county. It lay 2,110 li from the Provincial Administration Commission.
273
羅白州東北。 洪武三年置，屬思明府，後來屬。 南有隴冬水，下流入於麗江。
Luobai Prefecture lies to the northeast. Established in Hongwu 3, it belonged to Siming Prefecture and later came under Jiang Prefecture. To the south is Longdong Water, which flows down into the Lijiang.
274
思陵州元屬思明路。 洪武三年省入思明府。 二十一年正月復置，直隸布政司。 南有角硬山，角硬水出焉，又有淰削水合之，下流入思明府界。 距布政司二千一百二十里。
Siling Prefecture under the Yuan belonged to Siming Route. In Hongwu 3 it was merged into Siming Prefecture. In the first month of Hongwu 21 it was restored and came directly under the Provincial Administration Commission. To the south is Jiaoying Mountain, where Jiaoying Water rises; Nixiao Water joins it, and the stream flows down into Siming Prefecture. It lay 2,120 li from the Provincial Administration Commission.
275
憑祥州本憑祥縣。 永樂二年五月以思明府之憑祥鎮置，屬思明府。 成化十八年升爲州，直隸布政司。 西北有麗江，自交址廣源州流入。 又南有鎮南關，一名大南關，即界首關也。 距布政司二千四十里。
Pingxiang Prefecture was originally Pingxiang County. In the fifth month of Yongle 2 it was established from Pingxiang Town in Siming Prefecture and placed under that prefecture. In Chenghua 18 it was elevated to a prefecture and came directly under the Provincial Administration Commission. To the northwest is the Lijiang, flowing in from Guangyuan Prefecture in Jiaozhi. Farther south is Zhennan Pass, also called Danan Pass—the pass at the border head. It lay 2,040 li from the Provincial Administration Commission.
276
安隆長官司元致和元年三月置安隆州，屬雲南行省。 後廢爲寨，屬泗城州。 洪武三十五年十二月置安隆長官司，仍屬泗城州，後直隸布政司。 西有壩達山，渾水河經其下，即紅水江也，東入泗城州界。 又西南有同舍河。 距布政司裏。
The Anlong Native Official Office: under the Yuan, Anlong Prefecture was established in the third month of Zhihe 1 and placed under the Yunnan Branch Secretariat. It was later abolished and reduced to a stockade under Sicheng Prefecture. In the twelfth month of Hongwu 35 the Anlong Native Official Office was established, still under Sicheng Prefecture and later coming directly under the Provincial Administration Commission. To the west is Bada Mountain; the Hunshui River runs beneath it as the Red Water River and flows east into Sicheng Prefecture. Farther southwest is the Tongshe River. The distance from the Provincial Administration Commission is given only as li—the numeral is lost in the received text.
